Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
"Perfidio may burn 1 blood to untap and attempt to block a (D) action
that targets a location you control."

Just to clarify, this is not limited to once per action, correct?

That is, if Perfidio uses his ability, and the acting minion plays
Form of Mist or Mirror Image to continue the action, can he burn a
blood to untap and attempt to block again?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.
